root_cause.text: A race was introduced in the IPv6 neighbor discovery path because ndisc_router_discovery() accesses the shared in6_dev->ra_mtu field concurrently without synchronization or atomic access annotations.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly says “ndisc_router_discovery() could read and write in6_dev->ra_mtu without holding a lock,” and the patch changes `if (in6_dev->ra_mtu != mtu) { in6_dev->ra_mtu = mtu; }` to use `READ_ONCE(in6_dev->ra_mtu)` and `WRITE_ONCE(in6_dev->ra_mtu, mtu)` to document that unsynchronized concurrent access.
